spans.s:
. m. n. (-क्तः-क्तम्) (In the Prātiśakhyas.) A
particle consisting of a single vowel, viz. the prepos. आ
and the particle उ (which becomes ऊ); e. g. Prātiś. of the
Vājas.: एकवर्णं पदमपृक्तम्; or अपृक्तः स उ; Prātiś. of the
Ṛgv.: उकारश्चेतिकरणेन युक्तो रक्तोऽपृक्तो द्राघितः शाकलेन.
2. m. (-क्तः) (In the system of Pāṇini.) An affix the
real value of which consists of a single letter (according to
the Sūtra

.; but the practical purport of this general
rule is conveyed by the restrictions of two Vārttikas and
Patanjali's Bhāṣya to this effect, that in Pāṇini the term ap-
plies amongst affixes of a single consonant, to the affix व्
which is technically called क्विप्, क्विन् and ण्वि--comp.

.--, to the nom. sing. aff. स्--technic. सु--and
to the second and third pers. sing. of the imperf. स् and त्,
substitutes of सि and ति--; amongst affixes of a single
vowel, to अ which is technically अण्, to इ which is tech-
nically इञ्--comp.

.--, and, as Patanjali adds,
to अ, technically ण--comp.

.--). E. अ neg.
and पृक्त, 1. scil. कार or पद, 2. scil. प्रत्यय.

अपृणत् Tatpur. m. f. n. (-न्-ती-त्) (ved.) One who does
not propitiate (the gods with clarified butter or similar of-
ferings). E. अ neg. and पृणत्.

अपृथक् Tatpur. ind. Not separately, collectively, together
with; e. g. युतोऽन्वितेऽपृथक्, ‘युत means अन्वित and
अपृथक्’. E. अ neg. and पृथक्.

अपृथग्ग्रहण Tatpur. n. (-णम्) Not taking or perceiving se-
parately; e. g. in the Nyāya Sūtra: तदाश्रयत्वादपृथग्ग्रहणम्
‘there is no perception separately (of a web from its
threads)’, i. e. a web cannot be perceived separately from
its threads, since it consists thereof. E. अ neg. and पृथ-
ग्ग्रहण.

अपृष्ट Tatpur. m. f. n. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टम्) Unasked. E. अ neg.
and पृष्ट.
